entities.name: Procedure to indicate start
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to indicate start of location measurements or timing detection when measurement gaps are insufficient.

entities.name: Procedure to indicate stop
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to indicate stop of location measurements or timing detection.

entities.name: Measurement gaps needed and insufficient
entities.description: Condition where UE requires measurement gaps for location measurements or timing detection but gaps are either not configured or not sufficient.

entities.name: Preconfigured measurement gaps available
entities.description: Condition where preconfigured measurement gaps are configured and UE considers at least one meets measurement gap requirements.

entities.name: Stop indication from upper layers
entities.description: Condition where upper layers indicate to stop performing location measurements or timing detection and preConfigGapID is not activated.

entities.name: preConfigGapID activated
entities.description: Condition where preConfigGapID is currently activated.

entities.name: Measurement gap activation request
entities.description: Action to trigger lower layers to initiate measurement gap activation request using UL MAC CE.

entities.name: Measurement gap deactivation
entities.description: Action to trigger lower layers to deactivate current active measurement gap.

entities.name: Gap verification only on upper layer indication
entities.description: UE verifies measurement gap situation only upon receiving indication from upper layers.

relations.description: Procedure to indicate start is guarded by condition that measurement gaps are needed and insufficient.
Measurement gap activation is guarded by condition that preconfigured gaps are available.
Procedure to indicate stop is guarded by condition that upper layers indicate stop and preConfigGapID is not activated.
Measurement gap deactivation is guarded by condition that preConfigGapID is activated and upper layers request modification or indicate gap not needed.
Property establishes that UE only initiates procedure when gaps are insufficient upon upper layer indication.
